plank.name: Plank
plank.where: chop down a tree (swing at it; an axe is quickest), pull town furniture and doors down (B, then right-click), search houses, or chop them at a timber stand in the woods (E)

nails.name: Nails
nails.where: search hardware stores, garages and kitchens, or make them: a Press turns metal plates into nails

scrap_metal.name: Scrap metal
scrap_metal.where: strip a broken-down car or a wreck (swing at it), search cars, garages and trash, pull town furniture down (B, then right-click), or pull it from a scrap heap at the junkyard (E)

metal_plate.name: Metal plate
metal_plate.where: a smelter makes them from scrap metal (or search factories and garages)

dirty_water.name: Rainwater
dirty_water.where: a rain collector fills on its own, or draw it at a farm well (E)

seeds.name: Seeds
seeds.where: search kitchens, sheds and farms (a planter keeps its seed)

gas_can.name: Gas can
gas_can.where: search cars and the gas station, siphon a car (G), or drain a fuel tanker (E)

wall_panel.name: Wall panel
wall_panel.where: a Press makes them from metal plates (or search the industrial park)
